scale-projection.label: Scale / zoom / projection
scale-projection.canonicalQuestion: Does a world-space constant become visually wrong when magnified?

layout-posture.label: Layout mode / posture / safe area
layout-posture.canonicalQuestion: Can two subsystems classify the same viewport differently?

time-tempo.label: Time / tempo / duration
time-tempo.canonicalQuestion: Did a fixed timeout or window assume the old consumption rate?

media-topology.label: Media type / content topology / cardinality
media-topology.canonicalQuestion: Does a broader model feed a narrower production projection?

focus-ownership-async.label: Focus / ownership / async revision
focus-ownership-async.canonicalQuestion: Can an older owner or result commit after a newer intent already won?

semantic-reveal.label: Semantic reveal / data coverage
semantic-reveal.canonicalQuestion: Did revealing more data expose an old coverage hole?

rendering-layers.label: Rendering layers / occlusion / visual hierarchy
rendering-layers.canonicalQuestion: Do two representations of the same semantic object still share one anchor and owner?

quality-performance.label: Quality / performance tier
quality-performance.canonicalQuestion: Did performance degradation accidentally become semantic degradation?

authorization-identity-lifetime.label: Authorization identity and lifetime
authorization-identity-lifetime.canonicalQuestion: Can a changed or narrower identity reach state written for a different authority or lifetime?

request-replay-recovery.label: Request replay / recovery identity
request-replay-recovery.canonicalQuestion: Can a retry report success without durable evidence bound to the original intended operation?

resource-tenancy.label: Resource tenancy / lifecycle
resource-tenancy.canonicalQuestion: Did a new owner make a previously single-tenant budget or lifecycle shared?

invariants.title: One product mode per viewport
invariants.statement: One viewport resolves to exactly one product interaction mode; child subsystems do not independently re-derive phone or desktop from their own raw width thresholds.

invariants.title: One geographic anchor across layers
invariants.statement: A Route Point, marker, place label and route geometry share one geographic anchor at every supported zoom.

invariants.title: One tempo, one consumption rate
invariants.statement: One narrative tempo drives camera, arrival, media dwell and prefetch distance so all consumers describe the same rate.

invariants.title: Meaningful Route Points survive projections
invariants.statement: A Route Point the domain considers meaningful remains represented in every mode projection unless that mode explicitly permits omission.

invariants.title: Newer intent wins
invariants.statement: A newer focus, selection, seek or async scope wins; stale callbacks and settle results cannot reassert themselves afterward.

invariants.title: Low chrome removes redundancy, not capability
invariants.statement: Reduced chrome may remove redundant controls but cannot remove the only discoverable path to a capability.

invariants.title: Credentials never travel in URL path or query
invariants.statement: Bearer, share and recovery credentials live in authorization headers or URL fragments, never request paths/query strings or request logs.

invariants.title: Share scope closure
invariants.statement: Navigation, timeline, globe, Story and Playback under a share grant cannot leave the granted Journey set.

invariants.title: Read-only stays read-only
invariants.statement: A read-only capability never acquires mutation authority on a downstream surface it can reach.

invariants.title: Expiry and revocation propagate
invariants.statement: Expiry and revocation propagate to downstream reads, already-open surfaces and bounded presigned capabilities.

invariants.title: Public capabilities carry their own budget
invariants.statement: Abuse protection belongs to the public or costly endpoint that needs it and is charged to the subject that holds the capability.

invariants.title: Closer means more confidence
invariants.statement: Moving closer yields more geographic confidence, never larger decorative error or lower language/data confidence.

invariants.title: Single Projection Space
invariants.statement: One geographic point has one world position; every representing layer derives its screen anchor from the same projection frame.

invariants.title: Faithful Path
invariants.statement: The whole visible route curve satisfies bounded screen-space approximation error; decoration is reduced before path truth is truncated.

invariants.title: Stable user identity owns product data
invariants.statement: Email and login methods may change during an Account lifetime; product ownership remains anchored to stable user identity rather than mutable credential attributes.

invariants.title: Isolation has one effective interaction owner
invariants.statement: A lifecycle isolation state has one effective owner for visibility, hit testing and accessibility; cascade changes cannot leave an invisible surface interactive.

invariants.title: Retry success requires original-operation evidence
invariants.statement: A retry may report success only from durable evidence bound to the original intended operation, never by probing mutable state against the retry's possibly changed request body.

invariants.title: Rendering budgets are multi-tenant
invariants.statement: Once multiple renderers or GPU contexts can coexist, each budget is a tenant budget and total drawing-buffer/context lifetime must account for concurrent owners and deterministic teardown.
